standard_prerequisites.use: The relative map approximation lemma, completion of local rings, elementary etale neighbourhoods, and the lifting criterion for smoothness; the reduction is retained.

core_obligations: Replace the target by the controlling modification and show that the relevant completion maps are isomorphisms.
Apply the lifting criterion to obtain smoothness of f at the point, and combine with unramifiedness to conclude etaleness.

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to the controlling modification and set up the completions.
Show the completion map is an isomorphism for the relevant neighbourhoods.
Conclude smoothness at the point and hence etaleness.

difficulty_reason: Building on the relative map approximation lemma, the statement assumes that the given local map of completions is an isomorphism and concludes that the approximating diagram can be chosen with the map f etale. The proof first replaces the thickening target by the controlling modification, shows that the completion map is an isomorphism for the etale neighbourhoods involved, and then invokes the lifting criterion to see that f is smooth at the point; the etale conclusion follows because the source map is already unramified. The reduction of the completion isomorphism to smoothness at the point is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 11727-11798.
